title: The Mosaic Covenant II: Tabernacle and Holiness
subtitle: Exodus 25-40, Leviticus
theme: God designs a way to dwell among his people. Holiness, sacrifice, and mediation.
memoryText: For the life of the flesh is in the blood, and I have given it for you on the altar to make atonement for your souls.
reviewQuestions: What is the Tabernacle teaching us about how sinners can approach a holy God?
What does the sacrificial system reveal about the nature of atonement?
What happens on the Day of Atonement, and how does it point to Christ?
What does “be holy as I am holy” mean for the people of God?
psalmsNote: Who may approach a holy God: Psalms 15, 24, 51, 50, 40, 91, and 92.
